rows.text: **Addendum 2026-10-22 12:33:** NEW mark DIFF-TRK-1 (found by the wave-4 integration's differential, origin not yet attributed): epoll armed-fused, climon suite, atomic 0, seed 19, round 21 mode 1: TomoKV delivered two TRACKING invalidation frames for ck:10 where Redis 7.4.10 delivers one (receipt cx-wave4 docs/wave4/differ/epoll-armed-fused/climon-a0-s19-failure.txt). Tracking source and linked broadcast bodies are identical to the headline; a full replay and fresh controls on both headline and merged binaries passed. Candidate cause: notifyorder routes an attributed lazy-expiry invalidation through the command batch (writer_id = client) while the write's own invalidation follows. An extra invalidation is conservative (a missed one would be unsafe). Follow-up: statistical reproduction on headline vs merged. Also retained, pre-existing: cmdgap2 contradiction (headline-identical); 8 standalone ACL-wake fixtures rejecting a legal Defer.

**Addendum 2026-10-22 18:24 (WAVE 4 LANDED a7dfb9d23):** CLOSED: NT-new-4 (clock cut before inbox pop), NT-new-5 (kTLS gauge), NT-new-6 (pre-AUTH precedence), NT-new-7 (key deadline boundary), HX-3 (expired notification from an undecided candidate), D2 (atomic-0 cross-shard mover duplicate/loss), expiry/keymiss notification order, NO-A5 (local-script AOF group dropped with notifications). Gate 702, EXPECT 685/702. Still open: AT4.1-AT4.3 + TO-W1..3 + TO-DL1 (txnorder2 launching; owner APPROVED writer episodes 2026-10-22), DIFF-TRK-1, HX-LB-PROBE, NO-A1/A2/A3/A4/A6-A10, the T3 compat list, DB-1.

**Addendum 2026-10-22 19:39 (bugs5):** CD4.2, SV4.3, RL4.1 FIXED in cx-bugs5 (landing pending merit). IO4.3 REPRODUCED; needs a FLIP protocol extension (listener ownership transfer): OWNER DECISION. DIFF-TRK-1 ATTRIBUTED, pre-existing on 8656f9fa9 and a7dfb9d23 (20-30% of epoll armed-fused climon seed-19 runs): a pending-read registration is invalidated by an older write's delayed notification and the read's retirement re-enrolls the key, so the next write invalidates again (one redundant frame; never a missing one). Fix lane trackfix planned (causal ordering between the write's commit and the read's execution).

**Addendum 2026-10-23 02:34:** DIFF-TRK-1 FIXED in cx-trackfix (armed-tracking-only ordering stamps; landing pending merit); CC4.4 FIXED in cx-trackfix. NEW mark TRK-REDIR-1 (pre-existing, compat): CLIENT TRACKING REDIRECT to a connection that closes while an invalidation is in flight: the source resolves the redirect, posts to the target's IO, the target is gone and delivery returns silently, so the source's broken_redirect state (Redis: tracking-redir-broken) is never set. Planned in notifycompat.
